title: [HELP!] Xdrip early G5 transmitter death?
symptom: A new G5 transmitter (28 days old) used only with xDrip OB1 shows voltage A at 250, and later dies early. Subsequent transmitters also die early (around 60 days), while a transmitter first used with the Dexcom app lasted longer.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One user speculates that not using native mode on the G5 transmitter from the start may cause early battery drain, but maintainers dispute this, stating xDrip cannot affect transmitter power consumption.
fix: No definitive fix is stated. One user reports that enabling 'G5 Native' in xDrip made the transmitter last longer, but this is anecdotal and disputed.
evidence_quote: On my latest transmitter, I enabled 'G5 Native' in xdrip, and the transmitter seems to be lasting much longer.
